name: com.lemolatoon.udoncl
description: Transaction-safe Unity import for udoncl programs, Device kernels, UdonDNN/UdonBLAS, and ONNX execution plans.

samples.description: Call a Host C export that launches an OpenCL C kernel, then read its result back from U#.
Classify a hand-drawn digit with the MNIST CNN ONNX model through its generated U# binding.
Chat with TinyLlama-1.1B through a user-built 4096-token Chat Artifact and stream its replies.
Generate, import, and call a standard ONNX Add graph from U#.
Run a multi-operator Tiny Llama graph with typed token upload and asynchronous logits readback.
Drive a user-materialized Llama 3.1 8B artifact from U# without redistributing licensed weights.
